name: yrby-forms
description: Collaborative form fields over yrby: the <collaborative-form> and <collaborative-field> custom elements bind plain form controls to a shared Y.Doc through yrby-client's ActionCable provider. Last-write-wins fields via a shared map, character-merge text fields via Y.Text, and focus presence (outline + name chip). Rendered by the yrby-forms Rails gem's form helpers.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }) + '\n')"
